messages:
sarah.cs: Heads-up — Zenotic reports a billing + API problem. Sales promo from their contract wasn't applied to last invoice and they saw auth/latency spikes. Need manual credit + PO note.

jason.sales: On it. PO Z-7782, promo PROMO-ENT-2025 per SOW. Sales confirmed with them yesterday.

emily.finance: Can you paste the invoice id and account id? I need those to run a ledger adjustment and attach a note.

sarah.cs: Invoice INV-2025-98, account zntc-1073. They reported intermittent 401s during heavy ingest and multiple 503/latency spikes. They say tokens were billed without promo applying. PO link (internal): https://files.redwood/po/Z-7782

mike.eng-support: Looking at auth logs now. Can you share repro steps for the 401s? Curious if this was a rotated key or header missing.

sarah.cs: Repro the customer provided:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-zenotic-old" \
  -H "X-Customer-ID: zntc-1073" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi"}'

They say their key rotated but the app briefly used the old key. Also saw a 429 burst around 2025-11-03T14:02Z.

ops-bot: Alert: auth-service returned 401 spikes for zntc-1073 between 2025-11-03T13:58Z and 2025-11-03T14:05Z — 74 failures. trace_id=tr_9a8b

mike.eng-support: Root cause looks like the key rotation endpoint returned 502 for ~1m; our fallback path accepted the old token but token cache invalidation failed — led to auth errors and some duplicated retries. I'll open a PR for retries + fix cache invalidation.

jason.sales: :eyes: Ok. For now we need a manual credit equal to billed usage during that 7-min window and attach the PO note referencing SOW clause 3.4.

emily.finance: I can do the manual adjustment. Confirm amount to credit and exact time window + invoice id. Also need ledger code to post under.

sarah.cs: Customer's calc: $3,420. They expect full credit per contracted promo (50% monthly discount up to $10k) — system failed to apply it. Window: 2025-11-03T13:58Z to 2025-11-03T14:05Z. Invoice INV-2025-98.

emily.finance: Running adjustment now. Internal SQL command I will use:

INSERT INTO billing.adjustments (account_id, invoice_id, amount_cents, reason, reference) VALUES ('zntc-1073','INV-2025-98',342000,'manual promo credit per SOW PROMO-ENT-2025','PO Z-7782');

I'll also add a note on the invoice and reissue.

mike.eng-support: Confirmed we deployed a cache invalidation fix to token service and added an alert for rotation endpoint errors. Should stop recurrence.

ops-bot: Audit: adjustment created by emily.finance at 2025-11-05T09:12Z id=adj_4452

emily.finance: Adjustment applied, invoice reissued and PO note attached. Customer balance updated. Email sent to Zenotic finance, cc @jason.sales.

sarah.cs: :white_check_mark: Closing loop with the customer now. Thanks team. If they hit more API issues we'll reopen.

jason.sales: I'll draft a short playbook: 1) confirm PO/contract, 2) verify usage & window, 3) run internal adjustment, 4) notify customer & attach invoice note.

mike.eng-support: Follow-up task created ENG-3312: add retries + better cache invalidation for rotation endpoint. PR in review.

sarah.cs: Great, thread closed.
